comment: Example client configs for laptops on the same LAN. Replace 'your-mac.local' with your host's mDNS name or LAN IP. In route mode the host serves an 'orchestrator' plus a 'gemini-3.7-flash' worker from one endpoint; point the main model at 'orchestrator' and the worker/subagent model at 'gemini-3.7-flash'. Easiest of all: just run `ferry opencode` on the client to write the opencode block below automatically (it detects whatever the host is serving).

opencode._tip: Or just run `ferry opencode` on the client to write this automatically.

models.title: Ferry (orchestrator)
models._note: In route mode 'gemini-3.7-flash' is the cheaper worker model the host also serves.

cursor_ide._note: In route mode 'gemini-3.7-flash' is the cheaper worker model the host also serves.

generic_openai_sdk_python.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url='http://your-mac.local:8090/v1',
    api_key='local'
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model='orchestrator',
    messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Tell me a joke.'}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
